name: Souhrada Manufacturing Inc

about:
Souhrada Manufacturing Inc. operates from Tyndall, South Dakota, as a family-owned industrial sewing company. The business has been producing custom sewn products for more than 26 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. No founders are named in the company's public materials.

The company specializes in interior trim components for the heavy-truck market, including vinyl drapes, window curtains, mesh cabinet net assemblies, and custom straps. Beyond truck interiors, it produces soft-sided luggage, graduation gowns, pouches, industrial covers, heavy-duty nylon straps for agriculture, and fly-rod cases. Its facility houses more than a dozen industrial sewing machines (Brother, Juki, Mitsubishi) capable of single-needle, double-needle, zigzag, and four-thread serging, plus programmable bar-tack machines, a die-cutting press with a 60-by-17-inch bed, automated hot/cold strip cutters, a 60-foot spreading table, and an Eastman Brute vertical knife cutter that handles material up to 5.5 inches thick. Services extend to screen printing, embroidery, tensile testing, FMVSS 302 flammability testing, warehousing, and just-in-time distribution.

Primary customers are heavy-truck OEMs and tier suppliers seeking interior trim assemblies, but the shop also serves agricultural, luggage, apparel, and industrial-cover markets. The company emphasizes design collaboration, prototyping, material sourcing, and full order fulfillment from a single site.

Souhrada positions itself on personalized service, on-site quality control, production flexibility, and competitive pricing, aiming to be "the best sewing company" rather than the largest. Its stated mission stresses on-time delivery, a safe workplace, and long-term employee retention.
